subject: Social Studies
stem: The Constituent Assembly of India, tasked with drafting the Constitution, appointed a Drafting Committee to prepare the actual text — this committee was chaired by:
explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Constitution's Drafting Committee, earning him the title 'Father of the Indian Constitution' — Dr. Rajendra Prasad was instead the President of the Constituent Assembly as a whole, a distinct role.

section: Social Studies · Ch — Modern India & National Movement
subject: Social Studies
stem: After independence, the princely state of Hyderabad (ruled by the Nizam) initially refused to join the Indian Union; it was integrated into India in September 1948 through a military action codenamed:
explanation: Operation Polo (also called the 'Police Action'), led under Sardar Patel's direction, brought Hyderabad State into the Indian Union in September 1948 after the Nizam's resistance — Operation Vijay refers instead to the later annexation of Goa (1961).
